This model can also handle larger conditions depending on the surfer's experience. Description: The Fish made its appearance in the tail end of the 60's made famous by knee-boarder Steve Lis. The fish gained popularity and adopted by surfers in the early 70's. The Fish's main feature is its wide split tail and twin keels, but combined with its wide nose outline, flatter rocker and plenty of foam out to the rail, the Fish catches waves with ease and rockets down the line like no other short board can. Chris’s thought process in creating this board began with an outline reminiscent of the G&S ‘Classic Nose rider’, featuring a rounded yet slightly pulled-in nose template akin to the late Floyd Smith’s ‘Perfecto’ design. The midsection to tail incorporates ‘Classic Nose rider’ hips that subtly widen towards a broader tail, enhancing agility for swift and fluid pivot turns and effortless nose riding across diverse wave conditions. Engineered for superior stability, and culminates in a diamond tail, ensuring seamless and graceful maneuverability. Tailored to Mele’s dynamic style, this board enables rapid nose positioning for prolonged nose rides followed by smooth transitions for subsequent maneuvers. Versatile for surfers of all levels, it excels particularly in knee to head-high waves, offering optimal performance and control. This Model will be available in 9’2, 9’4, 9’6 and 9’8. “This special collaboration marks my homecoming to our family label after years of traveling, competing, and riding for various companies. The design of this board draws inspiration from my very first magic board shaped by my father, Masi Saili, which had a diamond tail. Ever since then, I’ve had a fondness for diamond tail boards. The KatWalk offers smooth and early entry into waves, excellent paddle power, and hips that make for smooth turns. It also provides lift for nose riding across different sections of the wave, all while keeping a nice trim.” - Mele Saili Fin set up/ Options: Recommended as a Single Fin. models.description: The "Perfecto" - Made to Order - takes 6-8 weeks. Call for a Shipping Quote Size range: 9’0″ – 10'6" Sample Dimensions: Length: 9’6″ Width: 23.25″ Nose: 18.5″ Tail: 16.75″ Thickness: 3.125″ Description: The Perfecto is Floyd Smith’s version of the “perfect longboard”. This board was designed with a wide point closer to center that makes it easier to maneuver while in the “trim position” on a wave. This design allows for some old school slipping and sliding. Great for small to medium surf for the intermediate to advanced surfer. Features: The rail from the nose starts as an upturned rail, which turns into a soft 60/40 rail in the middle, then into a hard edge in the tail. The dished out concave stops at around 21″ from the nose. The midpoint area is flat, which then turns into vee towards the tail. It has a flatter rocker in the middle but has extra rocker in the nose. Wide tail and parallel rails help stability and speed while in trim, while the sudden curve back in the tail allows for some fun classic style turns. It comes with 8oz volan glass on bottom, and a double 6oz glass with a 2/3rd’s 4oz deck patch on top, a “Perfecto” color design, and a single fin box. Designed by Larry Gordon & Floyd Smith with the input from Skip Frye and Mike Hynson, the Quarter Speed's main feature was having the wide point moved close to center for increased control and easier turning from the middle trim position. A great all-around board made for a wide range of skill levels and surf conditions that offers the perfect blend of speed and maneuverability. Features a medium wide outline with semi blunt nose, wide point near center with semi parallel rails and curved hip in the tail for quick smooth turns. Rails are "user friendly" with full 50/50 throughout for stability. Bottom contour is flat bottom to rolled "Vee" in the tail with concave in nose optional. Rocker is even and balanced for all around performance and maximum stoke. Fin set up/ Options: Recommended as a Single Fin. models.name: The Stretch Model
models.description: Size Range: 9' - 10'6 Sample Dimensions: Length: 9'6 Width: 23" Thickness: 3" Experience Level: Intermediate to Expert Wave Type: Best for clean, peeling waves knee to head high Shaped by: Chris Darby Description: Designed at G&S in 1965 by Mike Hynson with input from Skip Frye and Billy Hamilton for the Tom Morey Noseriding contest held that same year in Ventura. The Stretch is specifically designed to "Stretch" your time on the nose while still maintaining good overall performance. This was one of the first "reverse" rocker models made for noseriding. In addition, the nose is "cut off" so when nose riding, your weight is a few inches back from where it would normally be if the nose was still there…and it’s got a distinct look for the advanced surfer or the surfer new to nose riding that wants extra stability. Features a medium wide outline throughout with wide squared off nose, semi-parallel rails, and slight hip towards the tail with a wider tail block. Rails are medium full 50/50 to thinly foiled off the tail for extra hold and control. Bottom contour has medium concave in nose blending to flat bottom near center with rolled "Vee" in the tail. Rocker is balanced but with flatter entry in the nose and increased kick in the tail for better noseriding and easy turns off the tail. Fin set up/ Options: Recommended as a Single Fin. Standard Construction U.S. Blanks Green Density Foam with a 1" T-band with high density foam Stringer, 2-Layers of 6oz Glass on the deck with a Volan Deck patch and 1- 6oz Volan on the bottom with cut-laps for a classic clean look.
